compiled_from: Manually scoped public manufacturer and repair guidance; no independent experimental validation

sources.title: Bonding Low Surface Energy Plastics
sources.claim: DP8010 specialist two-part acrylic bonds many grades of PP and PE without special surface preparation; actual grade, geometry and loading need testing

sources.title: Engineered Plastics
sources.claim: ABS typically bonds more readily than polyolefins but differs by grade; PC surface coatings may complicate bonding

sources.title: Scotch-Weld DP100 Epoxy Adhesive
sources.claim: Rigid general-purpose epoxy for several substrates including various plastics; not an ABS/PC grade-specific performance warranty

sources.title: 4140 Flux Remover for PC Boards
sources.claim: Removes flux and ionic contamination from PCBs; reported compatible with most plastics, not all; inspect TDS and SDS

sources.title: 801B Super Contact Cleaner With PPE
sources.claim: Plastics-safe for most sensitive electronics substrates; contact cleaning leaves lubricating PPE protective film

sources.title: Contact Cleaner Range
sources.claim: 409B zero-residue fast-drying contact cleaner; avoid energized circuit cleaning because solvents can be flammable

sources.title: 419D Acrylic Conformal Coating
sources.claim: Protects PCBs against environmental contamination; repair/removal possible with specified methods, proper surface preparation and masking required

sources.title: 422B Silicone Modified Conformal Coating
sources.claim: Flexible PCB conformal coat for temperature cycling with rework potential; cleaning/masking and actual specification required

sources.title: ASA material guidance
sources.claim: ASA can be smoothed with acetone; solvent alters surface properties and vapors/handling require specialist safety review

sources.title: Electronics Water Damage
sources.claim: Assess liquid damage, isolate power and battery, expose contaminated assemblies; heating or bulging implies immediate safety stop

sources.title: What to do with a swollen battery
sources.claim: Battery swelling/heating requires specialized handling; flammable solvents near batteries introduce risk

methods.label: PCB-targeted flux-remover evaluation (MG 4140)
validation: Check board coating, seals, labels and adjacent plastics against current product TDS/SDS
Use an expendable coupon or unseen zone for compatibility before any application
Verify drying, absence of residue, corrosion and connector function before power restoration
failure_modes: Damage to unknown plastics and coatings

methods.label: MG 801B contact cleaning with protective film
validation: Verify a lubricating protective film is acceptable in the contact design
Check contact metallurgy, sensitive neighboring parts and TDS/SDS
Confirm stable contact resistance and cycling after controlled test
failure_modes: Inappropriate residual film in precision circuitry
Recurring corrosion from unresolved moisture ingress

methods.label: MG 409B zero-residue contact-cleaner evaluation
validation: Confirm exact 409B revision and zero-residue requirement
Verify nearby polymer and coating compatibility against exact TDS
Test contact resistance after cleaning and drying
failure_modes: Continuing wear or corrosion from missing environmental control

methods.label: 3M DP8010 specialty acrylic for PP/PE candidates
validation: Confirm exact PP/PE grade and surface treatments
Read current DP8010 TDS/SDS, surface preparation, environmental and cure restrictions
Test representative joint geometry for shear, peel, vibration and aging before reliance

methods.label: Investigate 3M DP100 for an engineered-plastic joint
validation: Obtain grade-specific ABS/PC bond-test data; generic plastics claims do not prove compatibility
Check rigid cure, stress concentration and crack growth against joint loading
Evaluate an independent mechanical replacement or fastening option
failure_modes: Permanent joint may compromise future repair

methods.label: MG 419D reworkable acrylic PCB conformal coat
validation: Identify keep-out zones: connectors, buttons, contacts, test points, sensors and heat interfaces
Verify cleanliness, TDS/SDS and coating compatibility with the populated assembly
Inspect coverage, adhesion, cure and rework performance on representative coupon

methods.label: MG 422B flexible silicone-modified PCB conformal coat
validation: Confirm environmental/temperature-cycling requirements and TDS applicability
Mask all electrical/mechanical interface keep-outs and test on a witness coupon
Verify cleanliness, adhesion, full cure, insulation and rework requirements
failure_modes: Unknown compatibility with populated device materials

methods.label: ASA solvent finish feasibility study (no physical procedure)
validation: Assess safer mechanical-finishing and replacement alternatives before using a solvent
Identify every adjacent polymer and sensitive component
Independent ventilation, chemical PPE, fire controls and solvent procedure review required
Inspect dimensional change and mechanical properties using a witness sample

methods.label: Power-isolated liquid-damage inspection and corrosion assessment
validation: Identify source and extent of moisture/ionic contamination
Check traces and connectors for material loss and recurring corrosion
Escalate any hot/bulging/swollen battery to qualified handling and replacement
failure_modes: Repeated failure from unresolved water ingress

methods.label: Replace part or pursue mechanical joint design instead of chemistry
validation: Confirm replacement geometry, fastener load path and part availability
Estimate replacement and labor costs from actual local offers
Inspect as-built fit and retention before accepting repair
